policyname: Users can read their own gallery comment reports

with_check:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (status = 'open'::text) AND ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) <= 80)) AND (char_length(body) <= 2000) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (gallery_comments c
     JOIN settlements s ON ((s.id = c.settlement_id)))
  WHERE ((c.id = gallery_comment_reports.comment_id) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (s.is_public = true)))))
